about: The write rule and the rules of display of the forms of stat, bargauge and piechart (10.3h, rules 4 and 8). A vector gives the options now, a row id and a value (or `remove`). It gives the options after the write (exact JSON, the order of 4.38) and the ids of the rows that show then, or an `error` text that the form shows under the control (nothing is written).

vectors.name: stat: fields pattern of the Grafana form
stat: fields pattern that does not compile
stat: fields escape outside the common subset
stat: justify center adds the member at the end
stat: justify auto removes the member
stat: display name keeps the other defaults in order
stat: display name empty removes the member
bargauge: orientation auto is not a value
bargauge: display mode lcd keeps the unfilled row
bargauge: display mode basic keeps the unfilled row
bargauge: unfilled row shows in lcd
pie: labels twice the same item
pie: tooltip all is valid and shows no sort row
pie: legend hidden hides mode, placement, values and sort
pie: legend hidden keeps the table rows hidden too
pie: legend shown again keeps the mode
pie: legend table shows values and sort
pie: legend sort by name shows sort descending
pie: legend sort by value shows sort descending
pie: legend sort by percent shows sort descending
pie: legend sort by a calculation is not a value of a pie
pie: legend sort descending false removes the member
pie: legend sort None removes sort_by and sort_desc
